from report import summarize


def test_basic_counts():
    """Test that summarize returns correct counts for basic statuses."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": "applied"},
        {"status": "Rejected"},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert isinstance(result, dict), "result should be a dict"
    assert set(result.keys()) == {"new", "applied", "rejected", "other"}, "result should have all four keys"
    assert result["new"] == 2, f"expected 2 new jobs, got {result['new']}"
    assert result["applied"] == 1, f"expected 1 applied job, got {result['applied']}"
    assert result["rejected"] == 1, f"expected 1 rejected job, got {result['rejected']}"
    assert result["other"] == 0, f"expected 0 other jobs, got {result['other']}"
    print("test_basic_counts passed")


def test_case_insensitive():
    """Test that status matching is case-insensitive."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": "NEW"},
        {"status": "New"},
        {"status": "new"},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result["new"] == 3, f"expected all three jobs to count as new, got {result['new']}"
    print("test_case_insensitive passed")


def test_whitespace_ignored():
    """Test that surrounding spaces are ignored."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": " new "},
        {"status": " applied"},
        {"status": "Rejected "},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result["new"] == 1, f"expected 1 new, got {result['new']}"
    assert result["applied"] == 1, f"expected 1 applied, got {result['applied']}"
    assert result["rejected"] == 1, f"expected 1 rejected, got {result['rejected']}"
    assert result["other"] == 0, f"expected 0 other, got {result['other']}"
    print("test_whitespace_ignored passed")


def test_missing_status():
    """Test that missing status counts as 'other'."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": "new"},
        {},  # missing status
        {"status": None},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result["new"] == 1, f"expected 1 new, got {result['new']}"
    assert result["other"] == 2, f"expected 2 other (missing/None), got {result['other']}"
    print("test_missing_status passed")


def test_unknown_status():
    """Test that unknown statuses count as 'other'."""
    jobs = [
        {"status": "pending"},
        {"status": "processing"},
        {"status": "completed"},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result["new"] == 0, f"expected 0 new, got {result['new']}"
    assert result["applied"] == 0, f"expected 0 applied, got {result['applied']}"
    assert result["rejected"] == 0, f"expected 0 rejected, got {result['rejected']}"
    assert result["other"] == 3, f"expected 3 other, got {result['other']}"
    print("test_unknown_status passed")


def test_all_four_keys_in_order():
    """Test that result has all four keys in the exact order: new, applied, rejected, other."""

        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": "applied"},
        {"status": "rejected"},
        {"status": "other_status"},
    ]

    keys = list(result.keys())
    assert keys == ["new", "applied", "rejected", "other"], f"keys must be in order new, applied, rejected, other, got {keys}"
    print("test_all_four_keys_in_order passed")
